sources.used_statement: Full main Theorem(4)-(6) PDF/printed3: finite cyclic quotient points and normalized boundary map isomorphism absent Ai; otherwise punctured torus/power map with finite ramification at Ai. FullPDF11 Proposition3.3,PDF12 Theorem3.4 and fullPDF13 proof plus Theorem3.5 and its proof: normalized type3 map is linear or power, ramification only at intersections with other exceptional curves; quotient endpoint location is retained. This is stronger than abstract power form alone. Original finite affine target preserved. Published geometry imported, not independently reproved.
